_doc: Division-level SOTP templates for conglomerate holding companies.
These three route to Financials/Holding Company, whose anchor `SOTP / NAV`
carries 0.70 weight and is implementable: False -- so 70% of a holdco's
valuation was a proxy. A bottom-up segment model is not the answer either:
their filings do not publish segment BALANCE SHEETS, so there is no basis
The practitioner method is a look-through: mark every listed stake at
MARKET (shares x price, never carrying value), value the unlisted operating
divisions on peer EV/EBITDA, sum, then apply a holding-company discount.
stake_pct = null means the ownership percentage is NOT yet sourced. Those
divisions are SKIPPED and the run is flagged incomplete rather than being
silently valued at zero or at a guessed stake -- a wrong ownership
percentage on a listed subsidiary moves the answer more than any multiple.

v2: ownership percentages sourced, and the two SGX holdcos added. PCRD holds 22.69% of PCCW plus a 1.92% DIRECT stake in HKT -- it does NOT hold a material direct stake in Singtel, which an earlier draft of this file wrongly recorded. Parts are converted to the holdco's reporting currency before being summed: Astra is quoted in IDR at ~190 trillion rupiah against a SGD parent, so an unconverted sum would be that one line and nothing else.

v3: five more templates from user-supplied ownership percentages with filing context (Kingboard/Laminates 61.74%, ThaiBev/F&N 69.61%, Wilmar/YKA 89.99% and AWL 56.94%, GenScript/Legend 45.03%). Each pairs its listed stakes with ONE stub division so the residual-EBITDA rule can complete them: group EBITDA less the whole of each CONSOLIDATED subsidiary's. Legend is an associate and is therefore not subtracted. Every stub multiple_range is an ASSUMPTION and says so in its source field -- the ownership percentages are sourced, the multiples are not.

v4: holdco discounts set by the user per name, replacing the placeholders. Two are STAKE-level, not group-level -- Kingboard 25% on the Laminates holding, GenScript 20% on the Legend mark -- so `discount_pct` now exists on a division and those two carry a group discount of zero. Discounts compose one way only: division first, group once on the total. Each template records the reasoning in `discount_source`.

v6: Olam and SingPost added with segment economics recorded in the template -- SGX publishes no machine-readable segment note, so the figures are user-supplied FY2024 / FY23-24 and each division states its own fiscal_year and source. Four bases beyond market_stake: transaction_anchor (a completed deal priced the division), cap_rate (income over a yield, for property), ev_ebit_range (stated EBIT against a peer band) and nil (an explicit, reasoned zero, which is not the same as a missing division). ThaiBev's template correctly excludes Frasers Property -- the ~28.78% stake was transferred to TCC Assets in the September 2024 swap that took F&N to 69.61%.

v6a: stated-figure divisions declare units_multiplier = 1e6. The published segment tables are in millions while market caps and net debt are absolute; without the scale the bridge subtracted a 13.8bn net debt from a 12,139 gross asset value and returned negative equity.

v6b: Olam's template currency is SGD, not USD. Divisions stay in their reported USD and convert per-division; the TEMPLATE currency has to be the listing currency because parent net debt reaches the bridge in it. Stated in USD, the bridge subtracted an SGD net debt from a USD gross asset value.

C07.SI.name: Jardine Cycle & Carriage

divisions.name: PT Astra International
divisions.source: controlling majority, commonly cited as 50.1%

C07.SI.discount_source: 10% baseline; brokers span 5% (DBS) to 15%. Among the tightest holdco haircuts in ASEAN -- strong direct dividend pass-through from Astra plus capital recycling (special distributions, Vietnam portfolio trimming).

P15.SI.name: Pacific Century Regional Developments

divisions.name: PCCW
divisions.source: primary look-through holding

divisions.name: HKT Trust and HKT
divisions.source: small DIRECT holding, separate from the PCCW look-through

P15.SI.discount_source: 20-30%: the discount the market itself has applied to PCRD's PCCW and HKT stakes net of parent debt over 3 years (Sep 2023-Sep 2026, 722 trading days): median 25.2%, interquartile 20.4-28.6%, 2026 median 20.6%. The earlier 40-50% baseline was double the observed range and put NAV 32% below price. Still a dividend-collection holding with no independent operating earnings and no privatisation catalyst.

00148.HK.name: Kingboard Holdings

divisions.name: Kingboard Laminates
divisions.source: 1,945,744,500 shares; direct parent holding, consolidated subsidiary

divisions.name: PCBs, Chemicals, Properties and Investments (stub)
divisions.source: STUB collapsing four reportable lines that should be valued separately: PCBs on peer P/E or EV/EBITDA, chemicals on commodity EV/EBITDA, investment properties and landbank on RNAV / cap rate, investments/others on carrying value. They are pooled because the HKEX segment note parses to revenue-only rows with unusable labels ('(Note a) a'), so a four-way split would be ALLOCATED rather than read. Valued as group EBITDA less the consolidated Laminates EBITDA at a cyclical-industrial range, which is an ASSUMPTION.

00148.HK.discount_source: 25% applied to the LISTED LAMINATES STAKE, not to the group. Kingboard monetises tranches of Laminates through secondary placements at 9-12% below last close, which caps how far the holdco gap can narrow. No second discount at group level -- that would take the same haircut twice.
_sotp_units_intended: Kingboard Laminates (1888.HK stake at market value)

Y92.SI.name: Thai Beverage

divisions.name: Fraser and Neave
divisions.source: raised from ~28% via the September 2024 TCC Assets share swap; now a consolidated subsidiary

divisions.name: Spirits, Beer, NAB and Food
divisions.source: STUB: group EBITDA less the consolidated F&N EBITDA. The four beverage segments carry different multiples and SGX publishes no machine-readable segment note, so they are valued as one pool. Frasers Property is NOT included -- ThaiBev exited its ~28.78% stake entirely in the same 2024 transaction.

Y92.SI.discount_source: 0-5% at group level, or 10% when the listed legs are isolated -- and this template isolates F&N, so the upper end applies. The September 2024 swap removed the property drag (Frasers exited to take F&N to 69.61%) and brokers value ThaiBev on blended core EV/EBITDA rather than a penalised stub. CAVEAT: Sabeco is the OTHER listed leg and is NOT isolated here -- no sourced ownership percentage -- so it still sits inside the stub.

F34.SI.name: Wilmar International

divisions.name: Yihai Kerry Arawana
divisions.source: consolidated China operations

divisions.name: AWL Agri Business
divisions.source: was a 43.94% equal JV with Adani; Wilmar crossed to 56.94% via Lence Pte Ltd after the Adani exit pact and CCI clearance

divisions.name: Remaining Wilmar operations
divisions.source: STUB: group EBITDA less the two consolidated listed subsidiaries. Multiple range is an ASSUMPTION for tropical oils, oilseeds and oleochemicals, not a sourced figure.

F34.SI.discount_source: 15-20% conglomerate discount, the sell-side convention (RHB, CGS). Yihai Kerry trades on a domestic A-share P/E structurally above Wilmar's own SGX band, so an unhedged look-through would inflate the target price.

01548.HK.name: GenScript Biotech

divisions.name: Legend Biotech
divisions.source: ~87.25M ordinary shares. Deconsolidated 18 Oct 2024: an ASSOCIATE under the equity method, so its EBITDA is not in GenScript's group figure and must not be subtracted.

divisions.name: Life Science, ProBio and Bestzyme
divisions.source: Group EBITDA, which already excludes Legend (an associate since Oct 2024). 17-23x EV/EBITDA brackets the HK-listed CRO/CDMO peer median of 19.9x TTM (WuXi AppTec 12.3x, WuXi Biologics 18.8x, Pharmaron 19.9x, Tigermed 26.9x, Asymchem 31.1x; FMP key-metrics TTM, 15 Sep 2026). The market-implied multiple for GenScript ex-Legend was ~23x. The earlier 9-13x was an unsourced assumption.

01548.HK.discount_source: 20% applied to the LEGEND EQUITY MARK, not to the group: high-beta Nasdaq biotech volatility, Carvykti commercial execution overhang, and parent-level holding frictions. Legend has been an associate since the October 2024 deconsolidation.

VC2.SI.name: Olam Group
VC2.SI.discount_source: Unchanged 10-15%: the post-reorganisation structure is itself the SOTP, and Olam Agri now carries a contracted put price rather than an estimate.

divisions.name: Olam Agri (19.99% retained, SALIC put)
divisions.source: Olam retains 19.99% after SALIC's Tranche 1 (44.58%, completed 27 Apr 2026 at US$1.88bn) following the 35.4% sale in 2022. Olam holds a put / SALIC a call on the 19.99% at a base consideration of ~US$799.6m (plus 6% p.a.), implying US$4.00bn for 100% of Olam Agri. Valued at the base put consideration: an equity claim on a deconsolidated associate, so no Olam Agri debt.

divisions.name: ofi (Olam Food Ingredients)
divisions.source: FY2025 ofi EBIT S$1,069.5m on revenue S$28,495.6m (2024: S$1,070.7m). 10-12x EV/EBIT from the standalone-IPO peer group (Kerry Group, Tate & Lyle, Givaudan).

divisions.name: Remaining Olam Group (OGH)
divisions.source: De-prioritised and gestating assets under divestment (e.g. remaining 32.4% of ARISE P&L agreed for US$175m; Terrascope sold for US$1m). Explicit zero; understates to the extent disposals fetch more.

net_debt_override.source: Olam 1H2026 results: net debt S$8,880.6m after Tranche 1 proceeds. RMI (S$7,344.6m) and secured receivables (S$358.0m) are NOT deducted: that inventory is working capital already inside ofi's EV/EBIT value, so deducting it too would count it twice (adjusted net debt S$1,178.0m would put NAV at S$2.69 against a S$1.02 price). Chosen by the owner on 2026-09-15.

S08.SI.name: Singapore Post
S08.SI.discount_source: Unchanged 10-15%: post-divestment the group is a property asset plus loss-making postal operations; separable, with modest conglomerate frictions.

divisions.name: Property Assets (SingPost Centre)
divisions.source: FY2025/26 Property Assets operating profit S$45.222m on revenue S$80.707m (year to 31 Mar 2026). 4.75-5.25% brackets the 5.0% implied by the independent fair value of the SingPost Centre commercial and retail building, S$906.907m at 31 Mar 2026 (valuer's range 3.75-6.00%). SingPost has said it will retain the centre.

divisions.name: Logistics & Letters
divisions.source: FY2025/26 operating LOSS S$6.103m on revenue S$303.454m. Loss-making domestic postal and logistics under the universal service obligation: an explicit zero, not a multiple of a loss.

divisions.name: Post Office Network
divisions.source: FY2025/26 operating LOSS S$10.682m on revenue S$11.161m. Explicit zero.

divisions.name: Perpetual securities (ahead of ordinary shares)
divisions.source: Perpetual securities of S$251.504m at 31 Mar 2026 (net cash S$184.702m excluding them, net debt S$66.802m including them). Equity-accounted but senior to ordinary shareholders, so deducted at face value.

net_debt_override.basis: reported net cash excluding perpetual securities
net_debt_override.source: SingPost FY2025/26 results: net cash S$184,702k. The Australia business (FMH) was sold on 27 Mar 2025 at A$1.02bn EV; the FMP balance sheet lags the proceeds and the S$202.6m special dividend.
